name: The Syndicate #9
description:
The Syndicate is an underground secret society made up of cyborg assassins. Each member has their own signature voice (leads). Their symbol, “The Dragonfly” has its own rhythm sequence (bass). And the aura that follows (drums). 

Different combinations produce different results and how you react depends on who is coming for you...
